form.billingKindOneTimeHint: Student charged once at enrollment signup. No further invoices on this enrollment.
form.billingKindRecurringHint: Billed every cycle. Enrollment auto-renews until withdrawn.
form.billingKindContractHint: Fixed-term enrollment with a defined end date. Can bill periodically within the term or as a single total at signup.
form.billingKindMilestoneHint: Invoice fires per milestone (enrollment term) as deliverables complete. Requires a Curriculum on the parent Program.
form.billingKindAdHocHint: Operator-requested sessions. Choose Total Program for a prepaid package or Per session for pay-per-session.
form.amountBasisPerCycleHint: Amount charged each billing cycle. Required for Recurring and Term-with-cycle enrollments.
form.amountBasisTotalPackageHint: Single total amount charged across the full enrollment term. One invoice covers everything; no per-cycle billing.
form.amountBasisDerivedFromLinesHint: Total computed automatically from the per-subject fee-schedule rows. Amount input is hidden when this is selected.
form.amountBasisPerOccurrenceHint: Amount charged per delivered session. Per-session enrollments only — each session fires its own invoice.
form.entitledOccurrencesInfo: Number of sessions included in the prepaid package. Required when amount basis is Total Program on a Per-session enrollment.
form.termOpenEndedHelp: Leave empty for open-ended / no expiration
form.scheduleLockedTooltip: This academic year is reserved for {{.ClientName}}.
form.scheduleAutoCreateHint: No academic year exists for {{.ClientName}} yet — one will be created automatically when you save.
form.scheduleAutoReuseHint: This program will be added to the existing academic year for {{.ClientName}}.
form.scheduleClientPickerNotice: Only programs assigned to this student are available below.
form.scheduleGeneralPickerNotice: Programs assigned specifically to students are not available for assignment to general-scoped academic years.
form.parentScheduleClientNotice: This academic year belongs to {{.ClientName}}. Programs created here will be available only for enrollments with this student.

messages.deleteNotAvailable: Subject fee plan delete is not available.
messages.inUseCannotModify: This program is in use by active enrollments. Subject fee and currency are locked.

errors.inUse: This program is in use by active enrollments and cannot be deleted.
errors.scheduleClientMismatch: Selected academic year belongs to a different student and cannot be attached to this program pricing.
errors.scheduleRequiredForClientScope: This program is scoped to a student. Pick or create an academic year for that student before adding program pricing.

validation.milestoneCyclicBlock: Milestone billing is not supported on cyclic programs (RECURRING / CONTRACT × PER_CYCLE / multi-session).
validation.adHocInvalidBasis: Per-session enrollments require amount basis = Total Program (package) or Per session.
validation.adHocBillingIncompatibleWithCycleCadence: Per-session enrollments cannot have a billing cycle.
validation.adHocVisitsPerCycleMustBeOne: Per-session enrollments cannot use multi-session cycles.
validation.adHocPoolNoTemplate: Per-session package enrollments require the Program to have a Curriculum.
validation.adHocPerCallNoTemplate: Per-session enrollments require the Program to have a Curriculum.
validation.adHocEntitlementRequired: Per-session package enrollments require entitled sessions > 0.
validation.adHocEntitlementInvalidForPerCall: Entitled sessions are only valid on package enrollments, not per-session.

perCycle.customer: Charged {{.Amount}} every {{.CycleLabel}}. Enrollment auto-renews until withdrawn.
perCycle.operations: Each cycle spawns {{.VisitsPerCycle}} Course(s) (if Program has a Curriculum). Course Plans tab shows cycle accordions.
perCycle.revenue: One invoice per cycle. Generate Invoice creates the invoice and (via piggyback) spawns the Course if missing.

derivedFromLines.operations: Each cycle spawns 1+ Courses. Course tracking flows through the Program's Curriculum.
derivedFromLines.revenue: Invoice total computed from academic year lines; one invoice per cycle.

totalPackage.operations: Enrollment spawns 1 lifetime Course (or cycle Courses if cyclic — see Program's visits_per_cycle).
totalPackage.revenue: One invoice at signup; cycle Courses are operational only.

totalPackage.operations: Lifetime Course with terms. BillingEvent rows gate per-milestone invoicing.
totalPackage.revenue: Invoice per milestone trigger; sum across milestones equals the total program.

totalPackage.operations: Enrollment spawns 1 lifetime Course with terms (if Program has a Curriculum).
totalPackage.revenue: One invoice at enrollment signup covering the full amount.

totalPackage.operations: Operator requests each session from the Course Plans tab. Package exhausts after {{.EntitledOccurrences}} sessions — operator can extend.
totalPackage.revenue: One invoice at enrollment signup covering the entire package; subsequent sessions are operationally tracked only.

perOccurrence.customer: Charged {{.Amount}} per session. No upfront cost.
perOccurrence.operations: Operator requests each session from the Course Plans tab. Each completed session flips its BillingEvent to READY for invoicing.
perOccurrence.revenue: One invoice per delivered session. Generate Invoice per session row.

warning.milestoneNoTemplate: Milestone billing requires the Program to have a Curriculum. Configure it on the Program first.
warning.recurringNoTemplate: This enrollment will not have course tracking. Add a Curriculum to the Program to enable cycle Courses.
warning.visitsPerCycleInvalidKind: visits_per_cycle is only valid for cyclic programs. Reset to 1 or change the billing kind.
warning.adHocPoolNoTemplate: Per-session package enrollments require a Curriculum so sessions can be tracked.
warning.adHocPerCallNoTemplate: Per-session enrollments require a Curriculum so sessions can be tracked.
warning.adHocNoEntitlement: Per-session package enrollments need entitled sessions > 0. Set the value or switch to per-session billing.
warning.adHocBillingCycleNotAllowed: Per-session enrollments are event-driven, not calendar-driven. Remove the billing cycle.
warning.adHocVisitsPerCycleNotAllowed: Per-session enrollments cannot use multi-session cycles. Reset visits_per_cycle to 1.

subscriptions.emptyMessage: Enrollments billing this program will appear here.
subscriptions.confirmDeleteMessage: Are you sure you want to delete enrollment %s? This action cannot be undone.
